description:
Practical home security for people who want to feel safer at home without spending thousands on complicated systems.

I’m John Moses. On this channel, I break down simple ways to protect your doors, windows, garage, bedroom, and property using affordable security devices, smart routines, and proven home-safety upgrades.

You’ll find videos on:

Home security systems
Door and window security
Security cameras and alarms
Cheap security upgrades that actually work
Nighttime safety routines
Home security for seniors and people living alone
Backup security during power outages
Common security mistakes homeowners overlook

No hype. No fearmongering. Just practical ways to make your home a much harder target.
